posts.text:
The incarceration rate of any city, country, or community should be directly proportional to the number of criminals within it.

And the fact that's not obvious to everybody is alarming.
posts.summary: Incarceration rates should match criminal populations; criticizes deviation from this principle

posts.text:
One of the most offensive ideas in the modern world is that adults are generally responsible for their own happiness and success.

People love to blame everyone and everything except themselves for their misery and failures.
posts.summary: Adults responsible for own happiness; criticizes blame-shifting culture
